headline_seed: Arson arrest made over largest of Washington state's wildfires - BBC
draft_text:
A 37-year-old man was arrested Monday in connection with the Old Trails Fire near Spokane, booked on first-degree arson and held on $1M bond. More than 700 structures destroyed; roughly 60,000 evacuated. CBS News and CNN both confirm.

And that's the mews.
